source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Algorithms 1–2 target p(Y(a,S=∅)); the paper states soundness, nonidentification for listed failures, and explicitly conjectures completeness.
Positive gID is reduced to classical ID subproblems and Algorithm 2 is sound and complete; its negative proof constructs positive model pairs through a linear system.
For maximal-regular CSI labels of observed root controls, identification is equivalent to identification in every context graph and the stated algorithm is sound and complete.

The paper gives sufficient identification-invariance conditions for clustering and transports do-calculus identifying functionals after pruning or clustering; it does not state a fixed-support selector-image inverse.
The paper derives inference machinery and a sound-and-complete nested-IPW algorithm for identifiable single-treatment/single-outcome hidden-variable DAG effects.
The paper defines finite canonical SCMs for finite endogenous domains and reduces its counterfactual-bound problem to a polynomial program.
The paper states a necessary-and-sufficient graphical condition and complete identification algorithm for joint interventional distributions in recursive semi-Markovian models.
